events.title: Shabbat Hanukkah Dinner
events.place: The Santa Monica Synagogue · 1260 18th St, Santa Monica
events.description:
Join us for a festive Hanukkah dinner on the eighth night of Hanukkah, after Shabbat services, catered by Canter’s: chicken, crispy latkes, vegetables and salad, with a vegetarian option, plus mini sufganiyot (Hanukkah donuts) from Randy’s and drinks.

$30 per person. This covers dinner, dessert and drinks. Please RSVP and prepay using the registration link below. If you prefer to pay in cash or by check, please email the synagogue office at office@thesms.org.
events.closing: Please bring your hanukkiyah and candles for our menorah lighting.

yearRound.title: Progressive Dinner
yearRound.description: Every Fall, we gather for appetizers and Havdalah, then visit the homes of fellow congregants for first and second courses, and then join as a group again for dessert.

yearRound.title: Movie Mavens
yearRound.description: Our current format is to watch the selected movie at home, every couple of months, and then join a discussion on Zoom on a Sunday morning at 11am.
